title: Reopening a replay shows a stale snapshot: ▶ on ember after two new /loop fires brought back the old window (49 beats, ends 19:53) instead of the session now (52 beats, ends 19:59)
repro: Open ember's replay and leave it open
Wait for a /loop fire (~5 min)
Click ▶ (row, hover list or Theater…) for ember again
expected: The replay shows the session as it is now (or offers a refresh)
actual: The existing window comes forward unchanged: 49 beats ending 01:53:08Z while the session holds 52 ending 01:59:35Z; the timeline is not re-read on reopen and there is no refresh control
truth: loop: claude running since 01:48Z, fires at 01:53:07Z, ~01:57:5xZ, 01:59:35Z

title: A long first prompt widens the whole Theater page past the window: stats, chapter label and the detail panel's ✕ are off-screen, and at the minimum size the clock and the newest 22% of the scrub bar are too
repro: Open any replay whose first prompt is long (kestrel, atlas, beacon, delta, vibepet)
Look at the header stats, the chapter label right of the clock, and the playhead position
Click a beat on the rail and look for the detail panel's ✕
Resize the window to its minimum (820×520)
expected: Everything fits the window; the playhead is centred
actual: At 1280×800 the page is 1403–1494 px wide: stats cut, chapter label cut, playhead and stage centred at 701–747 px instead of 640; detail panel at 996–1366 px with its ✕ at 1329–1353 px (outside the window). At 820×520 the page is still 1400 px: the scrub bar runs to x=1046, the clock sits at 1060–1148 px, so the latest events and the clock can't be reached. A short title (ember) fits

title: A command the user rejected replays as '✕ EXIT', as if it ran and failed; failed or rejected commands are not marked on the rail or scrub bar
repro: Open kestrel's replay
Step to any 'Run dry-run deploy script' command
expected: 'Rejected by you' (the command never ran); red marks for rejected/failed commands on the rail and scrub
actual: '✕ EXIT' under the rejection text for 20 of 22 commands; rail icons and scrub ticks look the same as successful commands
truth: 20 tool results read 'The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use…' (dismissed dialogs); no exit code

title: Opening the fan-out replay (delta, 33 subagent files) takes a median 192 ms to first frame, over 150 ms; a first open after a pause takes 245–313 ms
repro: ⋯ → Theater… → delta; close; repeat
Compare with kestrel/atlas/beacon
expected: First frame ≤ 150 ms for any session
actual: delta median 192 ms (n=8, 151–313); main spends a median 58 ms reading and building delta's timeline (vs 14–31 ms for others); first opens after a pause 245 ms (ember row) and 313 ms (delta)

title: A paused or finished replay keeps redrawing at 60 fps: 6.5% CPU in its renderer and +11.7 points for the whole app while nothing moves
repro: Open any replay; press Space (or let it reach the end)
Leave it on screen and read CPU
expected: No redraw while paused; near-zero CPU
actual: 59.7 fps of frames while paused; renderer 6.5% of a core (n=5); app total 14.7% with the paused replay open vs 3.0% closed

title: The chapter card types over the prompt already on stage: two copies of the prompt overlap for ~0.3 s on open and at every chapter
repro: Open kestrel's replay and watch the first second
Let it play into chapter 2
expected: The card covers the stage cleanly (or the stage waits for the card)
actual: 'CHAPTER 2 OF 26 / Run exac▌' types over 'PROMPT · Run exactly ./deploy.sh --dry-run again…' at a different size; same at open

title: Replay windows open at the same frame: three open replays sit exactly on top of each other and nothing lists or switches them
repro: Open replays of beacon, kestrel and vibepet (any entry point)
Look at the windows
expected: Cascaded windows (or one window with tabs), titles that tell sessions apart
actual: All three at x 80, y 25, 1280×800 on a 1440×900 display; only the newest is visible; titles 'Theater — <repo>' (two kestrel sessions get the same title); no Dock icon

title: No way to jump to 'now' in a replay: every replay starts at its first prompt (5+ h ago) and End/Home/PageDown do nothing
repro: Open kestrel's replay (26 chapters, 5.7 h)
Press End, Home, PageDown
expected: A key/button to jump to the latest moment, or opening at the latest chapter for a live session
actual: Nothing happens; reaching the latest events needs a drag to the far right of the scrub bar (off-screen at narrow widths)
truth: approval pending at the end of the session

title: Theater can't act on the session it replays: no jump to its terminal, no approve or reply, so a blocked session sends me back to the pet
repro: Open kestrel's replay while it waits on an approval
Look for any action on the session
expected: Jump / Approve / Reply (or 'back to this row') from the replay
actual: No action controls in the window; the replay is view-only

title: ▶ after dragging to the visible end does nothing: the clock already reads '1:09 / 1:09', play runs the last 164 ms and stops; a second ▶ restarts
repro: Open atlas's replay; pause
Drag or click the scrub bar to its right end
Press ▶
actual: First ▶ plays 164 ms and stops (looks like nothing happened); second ▶ restarts
